entities.name: Bougrat
entities.description: A nostalgic druid of the Cult of Yore on Ravnica who worships the Nephilim.

entities.name: Cult of Yore
entities.description: A cult reverent of Ravnica's ancient past before the Guildpact.

entities.name: Nephilim
entities.description: Ancient beings the cult believed to be awakening.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The structure Bougrat feels eroded nature's diversity.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: A guild whose members joined the Cult of Yore.

entities.name: Decamillennial
entities.description: The event Bougrat's actions led up to.

events.summary: Before the Decamillennial, Bougrat and the cult document stirrings in nature and believe they herald the Nephilim's awakening.
events.quote: Bougrat and his fellow cult members observed and documented the stirrings in the natural world as signs of change

events.summary: The Cult of Yore grows, attracting members including the Gruul, and Bougrat feels hopeful.
events.quote: As the Cult of Yore grew in numbers, it attracted members from various backgrounds

relations.quote: Bougrat is a druid of the Cult of Yore on Ravnica
